description: AgriTerra Analytics is developing FieldShift AI: a climate-adaptation decision engine translating NASA SMAP and POWER Earth observations into resilient multi-year crop rotations. We empower smallholder farmers facing drought and soil degradation with accessible web & SMS guidance. We welcome agronomists, Python/FastAPI developers, and UI designers eager to apply space data to global food security!
